label: I’m anxious or worried
line: Your brain is time-travelling into a future that hasn’t happened yet. Get it out of your head and onto the page.
tip: Do a physiological sigh: a long inhale through the nose, a short top-up inhale, then a long slow exhale through the mouth. Repeat 1–3 times.

label: I’m overwhelmed
line: Your nervous system is maxed out. First calm the body, then the brain can think again. One breath, one pause, one tiny thing.
tip: Try a physiological sigh right now: two quick inhales through the nose, then one long slow exhale. Do it 3 times.

label: I keep doomscrolling, snacking or shopping
line: That’s your brain hunting for a quick hit of dopamine. Give it a better one from your DOSE menu.
tip: Get your daily DOSE first thing: 30 minutes of sun, movement, connection and a small win. Start with 5 minutes dancing outside if that’s all you’ve got.

label: I keep avoiding the course
line: Nothing changes if nothing changes. Do the 1%: one video, one prompt, one breath. That counts.
tip: Ask yourself: if I did know why I’m avoiding it, what would it be? Most of the time it uncovers a belief.
jp: If I did know why I keep avoiding the course, what would it be? What belief is underneath that?

label: I keep sabotaging myself
line: Your unconscious mind isn’t out to get you. It’s trying to protect you. Ask it what from.
tip: Notice the moment just before the pattern kicks in. Awareness is the first rewire.

label: I want to change a habit
line: Every time you choose differently, you’re rewiring the path. Small reps add up.
tip: Swap, don’t just stop: put the healthier option where your hand already reaches (a book where you’d grab your phone).

label: I’m scared of change or staying stuck
line: Familiar isn’t the same as good for you. Your brain just prefers what it already knows.
tip: Change can be uncomfortable. Lean into it and remind yourself: I won’t die.

label: I don’t feel good enough
line: We’re all shit in the beginning. That’s the hierarchy of learning, not proof you can’t do it.
tip: Write the belief down, then ask: who taught me this, and is it actually true?

label: I blew up or snapped at someone
line: A blow-up is usually the stacking effect, not the last thing that happened.
tip: Use Pause and Rewind to replay it and rehearse the ending you’d choose next time.

label: I’m people-pleasing or can’t say no
line: Abandoning yourself to keep the peace isn’t peace. Notice which state you default to, and with who.
tip: Before you say yes, take one breath and ask: is this a yes, or a fear of disappointing them?

label: I’m exhausted or burnt out
line: Running on empty means your body needs refuelling before anything else. Start with small pockets of rest.
tip: Do the Vagal Tone Workout basics: DOSE, Breathe, Pause, Move. On a hard day, one pause and a little movement still count.

label: My body is aching or sending signals
line: Your body sends signals. Sometimes an aching back needs a different chair, and sometimes it needs a conversation.
tip: Check the basics first: water, food, movement, rest and sleep.

label: I can’t sleep
line: Your body needs a signal that it’s safe to switch off. Slow, long exhales are that signal.
tip: No screens before bed, read to tire your eyes, and do five minutes of slow breathing lying down.
jp: What feels unfinished right now? What am I afraid will happen if I stop and rest?

label: Someone said something that hurt
line: When something hits hard, it says more about the bullets in your gun than the person delivering it.
tip: Regulate first: breathe 5 in, 5 out, sway, soften your jaw and shoulders. Then get curious.

label: Someone is really annoying me
line: Perception is projection. What’s annoying you is a mirror for you to clean up.
tip: Ask: where in my life am I doing (or afraid of doing) this exact thing?

label: I’m struggling with someone I love
line: They were doing the best they could with the resources they had at the time. So were you.
tip: Step into their model of the world for a moment: their past, their upbringing, their reality. What do you notice?

label: I can’t let go of the past
line: Your past explains you. It doesn’t get to decide your future.
tip: Notice one way the past is still running the show today, and one tiny choice you could make differently.

label: I reacted badly and feel awful
line: You can’t undo it, but you can rewind it and rehearse a different ending.
tip: Be kind to yourself. Approach it with curiosity, not judgement.
jp: If I could rewind that moment, what would I want to do differently, and what did I need right then?

label: I’ve been neglecting myself
line: It might not be easy, but it is simple: water, food, movement, rest and sleep. Improve one by 1% today.
tip: Pick one thing you can easily change today and commit to doing it every day.

label: I can’t focus
line: Make it smaller and easier. One video, not a module.
tip: Headphones in, phone on do not disturb, body double with someone, and pick the time of day your brain is freshest.

label: I’m feeling flat or low
line: Make room for something that feels good: a little pleasure, connection, play or a small win.
tip: Put on a favourite song, cuddle your dog, laugh with someone, finish one small task.
jp: What need am I actually trying to meet right now, and what’s one healthy way to meet it today?

label: I don’t have time
line: If you think you don’t have time, make this so important you make time.
tip: What can you shrink or hand off this week? Meal prep, a cleaner, Mum cooking a few meals, watching while the dogs play at the park.
jp: What can I remove, shrink or ask for help with this week to make time for me?

label: I fell off and feel guilty
line: Pick the ball back up. It’s exactly where you left it, waiting for you.
tip: No catching up required. Do the next 1% action, today.
jp: What’s the 1% I can do today to get back in?

label: I don’t know what I want
line: Pick a great direction and point yourself toward it.
tip: Start with who you’re NOT anymore, then who you want to become.
jp: Who do I want to become by the end of this course? What do I have, and how do I feel?

label: I need to calm down fast
line: Your body already knows how to do this. You’re just pressing the reset button on purpose.
tip: Double inhale through the nose, long slow exhale through the mouth. Repeat 1–3 times.

label: I don’t know what I’m feeling
line: Feelings are information. Naming them is the first step to working with them, not against them.
tip: Put a hand on your chest and ask: where do I feel this in my body? Just notice.

label: I’m having a meltdown
line: You’re safe. Nothing to fix right now. Just get your body back on side, one breath at a time.
tip: Find 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear. Then one long slow exhale.

label: I’m stressed
line: Stress lives in the body. Move it out and slow it down, then your brain gets its thinking back.

label: I want to celebrate a win
line: Yes! Put it in your proof portfolio so your brain can’t forget it.

label: I can’t get motivated
line: Motivation follows action, not the other way round. Make the first step tiny.

label: My energy is all over the place
line: Notice what fills you up and what drains you, then plan more of the first one.

label: I want to feel happier
line: Happiness has ingredients. Your DOSE menu is your recipe card.

label: I feel disconnected from people
line: Connection is a need, not a nice-to-have. A hug, a chat, a laugh all count (that’s your oxytocin).

label: I can’t see their side
line: Everyone acts from their own map of the world. The Understanding Bridge helps you meet them on theirs.

label: My thoughts are spiralling
line: Thoughts aren’t facts. Catch one, write it down, and check it against your proof.

label: I keep reacting instead of responding
line: There’s a gap between what happens and what you do. Pause and Rewind helps you find it.

label: I feel restless and fidgety
line: Your body’s asking to move. Let it. Shake it out, dance, stim, walk.

label: How do I do my daily practice?
line: Your Vagal Tone Workout is four tiny daily practices. One thing is enough.
